it.method: nTLDData ricostruisce le piattaforme da nameserver nella root, endpoint RDAP e DNS inverso. «Curata» indica una firma infrastrutturale assegnata dalla fonte, non una verifica contrattuale indipendente; i cluster automatici mantengono il nome tecnico osservato. Abbiamo confrontato tutti i record con il corpus IANA archiviato: gli 8 ccTLD IDN presenti nella fonte sono esclusi, con elenco nel JSON. en.summary: 18 October 2026 snapshot: 1,123 gTLDs in scope, 1,101 attributed to 23 platforms and 22 unattributed. Identity Digital accounts for 458, GoDaddy Registry 208, CentralNic 87 and Nominet 79.
en.method: nTLDData reconstructs platforms from root nameservers, RDAP endpoints and reverse DNS. “Curated” means an infrastructure fingerprint assigned by the source, not an independent contractual check; automatic clusters retain the observed technical name. We joined every record to the archived IANA corpus: the source’s 8 IDN ccTLDs are excluded and listed in the JSON. The remaining 1,123 gTLDs are all delegated in the local corpus. .edu, .gov, .int and .mil are not covered. ccTLDs are not censused. Today’s provider is not projected onto history, and the owner’s address does not establish the service location.
